_comment: Battle AI army-plan vocabulary: defensive doctrine profile (data/doctrines/defensive.json) executing PLAN_DEFEND. Team 1 deploys 3 units under defensive doctrine. Unlike default aggressive AI which rushes forward immediately across the field, team 1 unengaged units hold their defensive line at spawn in formation via _defend_hold_directives. When the player unit advances and engages the center, the defensive line holds firm and provides mutual support.
